description:
Use this when the user wants to change how a clip looks, at editor depth: "make the captions look like a
        gaming channel's", "give it a cinematic color grade", "add a glitch at the drop", "make it square for
        Instagram", "speed it up a bit", "fade it out". clip_id: from list_clips. Set only what was asked; names from
        edit_catalog.
        Captions: caption_template, font, caption_stroke_width 0-20, caption_stroke_color, caption_shadow,
        caption_box off/word/line. Color: filter_look (or off), filter_strength 0-100, brightness and contrast
        0.5-1.5, saturation 0-2, warmth -1 to 1. Motion: effect (or off), whole clip or effect_start_seconds to
        effect_end_seconds (0 = end), effect_strength 0-1; transition at inner cuts, transition_ms 60-2000; speed
        0.75-1.5. Frame: output_shape 9:16/4:5/1:1/16:9, progress_bar, fade_in_seconds, fade_out_seconds 0-3.
        "Like last time": template (edit_catalog kind templates), alone; template_parts (default all).
        "My usual style on these clips": clipping_preset (list_clipping_presets), alone, on clip_id and also_clip_ids
        (49 more); template_parts: captions, layout, headline, logo, music, overlays. Words, trim and crop stay.
        Not for: caption size or colors, music, silences, hook title (edit_clip), text, stickers, sounds
        (add_to_clip), translation (translate_captions). An undoable version; the render replaces the clip. Costs
        no Horizon Units. Returns job_id: poll job_status, then preview_frame. Options the account lacks are refused by
        name first.
name: style_clip
title: Style a clip
